name: Ivalua
description: Connect your own Ivalua Source-to-Pay tenant through OAuth2 client credentials. Read and safely manage Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Suppliers, Invoices, Sourcing Events, Contracts, and Catalog Items through the tenant's configured REST web services.

tools.name: connect_ivalua
tools.description: Connect an Ivalua Source-to-Pay tenant (OAuth2 client credentials), after validating connectivity.

tenant_url.description: Ivalua tenant base URL, e.g. https://acme.ivalua.app.
tenant_url.title: Tenant Url

api_path_prefix.description: API path prefix for this tenant. Ivalua does not publish one universal path -- leave the default unless your Ivalua admin tells you otherwise.
api_path_prefix.title: Api Path Prefix

client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID issued by your Ivalua tenant administrator.
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret for that client.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

tools.name: disconnect_ivalua
tools.description: Disconnect one Ivalua tenant: deletes only the credentials saved in Imperal. Nothing is changed in Ivalua.

connection_id.description: Saved Ivalua tenant connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Ivalua tenants.

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.description: List Requisitions on the connected Ivalua tenant, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional requisition status filter, e.g. approved, pending_approval.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_requisition
tools.description: Read one Requisition in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a new Requisition with line items.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

requested_by_email.description: Email of the Ivalua user this requisition is created for.
requested_by_email.title: Requested By Email

lines.description: List of {description, quantity, price, need_by_date} line dicts.
lines.title: Lines

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List Purchase Orders, optionally filtered by supplier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read one Purchase Order in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_purchase_order
tools.description: Create a new Purchase Order with line items.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

supplier_id.description: Ivalua supplier unique identifier this PO is issued to.
supplier_id.title: Supplier Id

lines.description: List of {description, quantity, price} line dicts.
lines.title: Lines

tools.name: approve_purchase_order
tools.description: Approve/release a Purchase Order that is pending approval.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

order_id.description: Ivalua purchase order unique identifier to approve/release.
order_id.title: Order Id

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description: List Suppliers registered on this Ivalua tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Read one Supplier in full by its Supplier ID.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_supplier
tools.description: Create a new Supplier record (onboarding).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List Invoices, optionally filtered by status (including 3-way match status).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional invoice status filter, e.g. approved, disputed, matched, exception.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Read one Invoice in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_sourcing_events
tools.description: List Sourcing Events (RFQ/RFP/auction projects), optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: Optional sourcing event status filter, e.g. open, closed, awarded.
status.title: Status

tools.name: get_sourcing_event
tools.description: Read one Sourcing Event in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List Contracts, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Read one Contract in full by its unique identifier.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_catalog_items
tools.description: List catalog items (punch-out/internal catalog), optionally filtered by name/SKU.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Optional catalog item name/SKU search filter.
query.title: Query

tools.name: audit_ivalua_access
tools.description: Probe every core Ivalua module (Requisitions, POs, Suppliers, Invoices, Sourcing Events, Contracts, Catalog Items) and report which are actually reachable for this tenant, without changing anything.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Ivalua tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: ivalua_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Ivalua tenants and encrypted OAuth credentials. Managed only through connect_ivalua and disconnect_ivalua.
